name: Nextcloud News
template: <Stack gap="sm" p="sm" h="100%" style={{ overflow: "hidden" }}><Group justify="space-between" wrap="nowrap" style={{ flexShrink: 0 }}><Group gap="xs" wrap="nowrap"><Image src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/homarr-labs/dashboard-icons/svg/nextcloud.svg" w={28} h={28} /><Stack gap={0}><Text fw={700} size="md">Nextcloud News</Text><Text size="xs" c="dimmed">Ungelesene Einträge</Text></Stack></Group><Group gap="xs" wrap="nowrap">{(data.items?.items?.length ?? 0) > 0 ? <ActionButton requestId="markShownRead" params={{ newestItemId: data.items.items.reduce((m, i) => (i.id > m ? i.id : m), 0) }} label="Angezeigte gelesen" icon="check" variant="light" color="blue" size="xs" confirmMessage="Die angezeigten Einträge als gelesen markieren?" successMessage="Angezeigte als gelesen markiert" /> : null}<RefreshButton /></Group></Group><ScrollArea style={{ flex: 1, minHeight: 0 }} type="auto" offsetScrollbars>{status.items?.loading || status.feeds?.loading ? <Skeleton height={300} radius="md" /> : status.items?.error ? <Alert color="red">{status.items.error}</Alert> : (data.items?.items?.length ?? 0) === 0 ? <Text ta="center" c="dimmed" size="sm">Keine ungelesenen Einträge 🎉</Text> : <Stack gap="xs">{data.items.items.map((item) => <Card key={item.id} withBorder radius="md" padding="xs" shadow="sm"><Stack gap={2}><Group justify="space-between" wrap="nowrap"><Text size="xs" c="dimmed" truncate>{data.feeds?.feeds?.find((f) => f.id === item.feedId)?.title ?? "Feed"}</Text><Group gap={4} wrap="nowrap">{item.starred ? <Badge size="xs" color="yellow" variant="light">★</Badge> : null}<ActionButton requestId="markRead" params={{ id: item.id }} label="Gelesen" icon="check" variant="subtle" color="gray" size="xs" /></Group></Group><Anchor href={item.url} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" c="blue.4" underline="hover" size="sm" fw={600} lineClamp={2}>{item.title}</Anchor>{item.author ? <Text size="xs" c="dimmed" truncate>{item.author}</Text> : null}</Stack></Card>)}</Stack>}</ScrollArea></Stack>
